cost: For S systems, R seeds, T tokens, N sentences and B resamples: O(SRT+SRBN), plus O(SB log B) sorting and group/example sorting. Retains O(SRN+SRT+B+report bytes). Reads full gold twice, no streaming guarantee.
description: Paired synthetic/system report orchestration with sentence metrics, seed means, bootstrap intervals, token grouping and examples.
forward: System::load reads files in order and checks sentence count, then id/token-count for each pair; no files fails after loop. report reads gold twice via permissive and raw views, checks context count, aggregates seed-level metrics, resamples identical sentence indices for baseline/system, renders focused breakdown only if 0<focus<systems.len().
inverse: R(report) includes all run/gold families producing rounded aggregate tables, grouped counts and selected examples; means erase seed identity, two-decimal rounding merges values, omitted examples prevent unique sentence reconstruction.
limitations: Public System can bypass load invariants and cause panic/truncating zip
Empty systems panics, zero bootstrap panics when comparison requested, empty seed mean can be NaN
No corpus, trained systems or statistical confidence calibration
state: Gold sentences, systems each containing ordered runs, RNG state, score accumulators and output string.
